attributes.probed_form: KEPT, eleven literal sites in StandardCamera_8002B828 replaced by externs the TU ALREADY declared and left unused - the planted-unused-extern signal: `1.570796327` -> `lbl_80346180` (2 sites, L1962/L1964), `3.141592654` -> `lbl_80345F58` (3 sites), `6.283185308` -> `lbl_80345F60` (4 sites), `-3.141592654` -> `lbl_80345F68` (2 sites). Values verified equal from build/GUNE5D/asm/auto_11_80345D70_sdata2.s (.double 3.141592654 / 6.283185308 / -3.141592654 / 1.570796327) before editing, so this is a spelling change with identical arithmetic. HAZARD WORTH REPEATING: `3.141592654` is a SUBSTRING of `-3.141592654`, so a replace_all on the positive token silently corrupts the two negative sites into `-lbl_80345F58`; the sites were edited as two whole guarded blocks instead, and occurrences were counted before any edit. EVIDENCE THAT THIS IS THE INTENDED FORM, beyond the score: lbl_80346180 is declared at combat.c:1734, in the declaration block immediately preceding StandardCamera, and was UNUSED before this edit; and the same function already spelled the same value as lbl_80345F58 at L2195/L2197, so the TU was internally inconsistent and emitting duplicate pool entries for constants it already named.
